images.author: owner-supplied
images.note: Owner playtest verdict ('sad', 2026-07-09): Clark/Addison intersection reads empty and flat — backdrop-grade walls on faces the player walks past, no streetscape rhythm. Judged by task 016 (streetscape) + 010 (bar likenesses).

images.author: owner-supplied
images.note: Owner playtest verdict ('sad and unremarkable', 2026-07-09): the Clark bar row is gray prisms with small signs — no doors, glazing, awnings or furniture. Judged by tasks 016 + 010.

images.author: owner-supplied
images.note: Owner playtest verdict ('neon sign cut off', 2026-07-09): the CUBBY BEAR fascia sign clips past the building top; Budweiser window neon also clips its plate edge. Sign plates must clamp to face bounds (issue 001). Judged by tasks 010 + 016.

images.author: owner-supplied
images.note: Owner playtest ('lights or awning - unsure what this is', 2026-07-09): green awning slats + white valance ribs float detached ahead of the Clark bar-row facades. Filed as issue 002; routed to the streetscape rework (016).

images.author: owner-supplied
images.note: Owner playtest ('doesn't stop flashing when you walk by it', 2026-07-09): Gallagher Way splash pad shimmered — wet-ring decal coplanar with the pad top (z-fight). Issue 003; FIXED in task 012 (ring rebuilt 15 mm proud, verified by act.mjs walk-past).

images.author: owner-supplied
images.note: Owner playtest ('double signs - same exact windows-doors on each', 2026-07-09): bar row shows duplicate sign pairs and copy-paste storefronts. Issue 004; routed to task 016 (dedupe + diversify).

images.author: owner-supplied
images.note: Owner playtest ('bag toss looks bad and spot is not solid color', 2026-07-09): Gallagher cornhole reads as flat slabs (issue 005 → task 019 wedge rework); the 'not solid color' spot is the splash-pad wet-ring dither (issue 003; fixed in 012).
